note: BH-7725 (UNB-3). The fallback: every stall no other rule takes becomes one escalation card (bin/lib/unblock/card.sh) to the operator through the critical alert DM. never_auto maps a proposal key glob (case-insensitive) to the class the card carries; a spend key is never acted on. One card per subject and head. Nothing runs on silence: an unanswered card expires.
